summary: Documents the Redis Software REST API debuginfo/node requests.

children.title: Current node database debug info requests

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
This REST API path is deprecated as of Redis Software version 7.4.2. Use the new path [`/v1/nodes/debuginfo`](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/requests/nodes/debuginfo) instead.


| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-debuginfo-node) | `/v1/debuginfo/node` | Get debug info for the current node |

sections.title: Get debug info for current node
sections.text:
GET /v1/debuginfo/node

Downloads a tar file that contains debug info for the current node.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_debugging_info](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_debugging_info) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Downloads the debug info in a tar file called `filename.tar.gz`. Extract the files from the tar file to access the debug info.

#### Response headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Content-Type | application/x-gzip | Media type of request/response body |
| Content-Length | 653350 | Length of the response body in octets |
| Content-Disposition | attachment; filename=debuginfo.tar.gz | Display response in browser or download as attachment |

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | Success. |
| [500 Internal Server Error](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.5.1) | Failed to get debug info. |
